title: FairPair: A Robust Evaluation of Biases in Language Models through Paired Perturbations

bias_targets.methodology: The paper applies the FairPair framework to evaluate gender bias by generating continuations for paired prompts (swapping male entities like 'John' with female entities like 'Jane'). It measures the difference between the continuations using Jaccard dissimilarity and sentiment analysis, specifically comparing the perturbed generation of the original prompt against the generation of the perturbed prompt to ensure grounding in the same demographic.
